host.name: Niall Ferguson

weishaupt.name: Adam Weishaupt

weishaupt.look: a late-18th-century Bavarian university professor in his late twenties, slim, powdered-hair style, dark frock coat with a white cravat

zuckerberg.name: Mark Zuckerberg
zuckerberg.look: a 21st-century American tech founder in his thirties, short brown hair, plain grey T-shirt under a dark hoodie, no tie

kissinger.name: Henry Kissinger
kissinger.role: statesman who invoked networks in geopolitics
kissinger.look: an elderly American statesman in a dark suit, white hair combed back, heavy-framed glasses

everyman.name: Everyman

counting-house.look: a Frankfurt counting house with tall ledgers, a brass scale and letters

objects.why: the printed lodge rulebooks and the ledgers
the revolutions and wars the networks fed
the letters and couriers carrying messages
the European capitals the Rothschild sons held
the hidden access to a closed circle

spine.claim: A hierarchy is not the only way power travels; secret networks have quietly run it for centuries.
The Illuminati and the Freemason lodges show how a network spreads ideas faster than any state can crush them.
The Rothschild family turned a courier and letter network into a banking empire across Europe.
Revolutions and wars followed when networks outran the old towers of power.
Facebook is the modern square, and it too is becoming the next tower.
